chapter: Pianists, radio and cafes of old New Orleans
title: Piano-and-drums cafes and the other side of the tracks
summary: Tom Zimmerman played Anderson's with a drummer; bands played across the track, where Allen's teacher Manuel Manetta and the Tuxedo were.
